hero.title: Pantai Kelapa Tuban
hero.lead: A family beach in Tuban with plenty of rides, seafood, and camping by the sea.

about.title: About Pantai Kelapa
about.body: Pantai Kelapa Tuban sits on the Tuban–Gresik road at km 1–2, in Kepoh, Panyuran, Palang. Shady coconut and pine trees, a mangrove forest, and plenty of rides make it a favourite for families looking for a relaxed day by the sea.

testimonials.title: What Visitors Say
testimonials.t1: I just came back from there. It's clean and comfortable, and there's camping too.
testimonials.t2: The beach is cool and shady, great for a family picnic. Lots of fun rides, and the entrance ticket is cheap.
testimonials.t3: So many memories at Pantai Kelapa. Camping there was so much fun.
testimonials.t4: It's a pretty place to hang out with friends. Camping is fun too, especially with the sunset.

faq.title: Common Questions

q1.q: Is Pantai Kelapa open every day?
q1.a: Yes, Pantai Kelapa is open every day from 08:00 to 17:00 WIB.

q2.a: Yes, there is a large, secure parking area for private vehicles.

q3.a: Yes, clean and comfortable bathrooms are available for visitors.

q4.a: Yes, there is a wide choice of tasty, fresh food and drinks.

location.title: Location & Directions
location.lead: Pantai Kelapa is easy to reach from central Tuban and the Pantura highway.
location.route1: About 5 km toward Palang, close and easy to find.
location.route2: Follow the Tuban–Gresik road to km 1–2 in Kepoh, Panyuran.
location.route3: Follow the Pantura highway to Tuban, then continue toward Palang.
